summary: San Francisco Bay Area, data scientist, background in sociology and economics, strong interest in social justice and systemic critique, advocates for collective action and anti-capitalism, engaged in discussions about mental health and societal structures, critical of big tech and its impact on society, emphasizes the importance of emotional vulnerability in relationships, active in online communities focused on data science and social issues, has children, values emotional openness and deep friendships, interested in the intersection of technology and social dynamics, critiques of neoliberalism and capitalism, supports the idea of universal basic income and labor rights.
